_meta.description: Parallel TTS performance text for ElevenLabs v3 audio tags. game_text mirrors Ren'Py display lines; tts_text is never written into game/*.rpy.
_meta.instructions: Edit tts_text only in this file. Run sync_voice_performance_manifest.py after adding voice lines to the game. Regenerate with regenerate_voice_with_metadata.py and ELEVENLABS_MODEL_ID=eleven_v3 (or --model eleven_v3).

entries.game_text: Done complaining?
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Done complaining?

entries.game_text: Wrong door. Again.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Wrong door. Again.

entries.game_text: Still there? Knock if you want something.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Still there? Knock if you want something.

entries.game_text: Smarter the second time. Knock.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Smarter the second time. Knock.

entries.game_text: Enter. You can knock when you want something. Try standing still next.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [dismissive] Enter. You can knock when you want something. Try standing still next.

entries.game_text: Tedious. Correct, but tedious.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Tedious. Correct, but tedious.

entries.game_text: At least your bow didn't wobble. Continue, briefly.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] At least your courtesy bow didn't wobble. Continue, briefly.

entries.game_text: Plain speech. You waste less of my evening than most.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Plain speech. You waste less of my evening than most.

entries.game_text: Names and purpose. Quickly.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Names and purpose. Quickly.

entries.game_text: Humor in my office. Brave or stupid.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Humor in my office. Brave or stupid.

entries.game_text: We'll discover which tonight.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll discover which tonight.

entries.game_text: Emerald Magistrate Kitsu Kaoru. You will use my title if you wish to leave with a seal.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Emerald Magistrate Kitsu Kaoru. You will use my title if you wish to leave with a seal.

entries.game_text: State your business. Briefly.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [dismissive] State your business. Briefly.

entries.game_text: Crane hair, Unicorn permit dates. Wrong clan for this desk; wrong week to fix it.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Crane hair, [short pause] Unicorn permit dates. Wrong clan for this desk; wrong week to fix it.

entries.game_text: Posture on the cushion. We'll see if your feet match your bow.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Posture on the cushion. We'll see if your feet match your courtesy bow.

entries.game_text: Flexibility. The roads teach what the Academy cannot. Sit, and show me the rest is more than posture.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Flexibility. [short pause] The roads teach what the Academy cannot. Sit, and show me the rest is more than posture.

entries.game_text: Survivable. We'll test that claim before dawn.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Survivable. We'll test that claim before dawn.

entries.game_text: Interclan residence requires Emerald approval. You knew that.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Interclan residence requires Emerald approval. You knew that.

entries.game_text: It does. Door.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] It does. Door.

entries.game_text: Better. Most Crane can't resist cataloging a room like a museum.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [calm] Better. Most Crane can't resist cataloging a room like a museum.

entries.game_text: I said sit. Not catalog my trophies.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] I said sit. Not catalog my trophies.

entries.game_text: Since you admire my shelves so freely, you may admire the seal from a distance. If you ever earn it.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Since you admire my shelves so freely, you may admire the seal from a distance. [short pause] If you ever earn it.

entries.game_text: Cushion. Floor. You stand too much for someone begging favors.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Cushion. Floor. You stand too much for someone begging favors.

entries.game_text: These dates.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] These dates.

entries.game_text: They are not. Your permit expired. Unicorn bureaucracy failed to mention it?
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] They are not. Your permit expired. Unicorn bureaucracy failed to mention it?

entries.game_text: How obedient. The Unicorn taught you to yield before the fight begins.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] How obedient. The Unicorn taught you to yield before the fight begins.

entries.game_text: Unfortunately for your travel plans, I'm not finished with you.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Unfortunately for your travel plans, I'm not finished with you.

entries.game_text: Requirements. Finally, a useful word.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [warmly] Requirements. Finally, a useful word.

entries.game_text: Most petitioners wail. You ask for terms. That almost earns respect.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [warmly] Most petitioners wail. You ask for terms. That almost earns respect.

entries.game_text: Tragic. Continue.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tragic. Continue.

entries.game_text: A curry shop and borrowed bedding. Ryoko Owari's finest import.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] A curry shop and borrowed bedding. Ryoko Owari's finest import.

entries.game_text: We'll see what it's worth.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll see what it's worth.

entries.game_text: No local patrons. No endorsements.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] No local patrons. No endorsements.

entries.game_text: High society.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] High society.

entries.game_text: Proof requires more than appetite. Tut.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Proof requires more than appetite. Tut.

entries.game_text: Tomorrow is generous. Tut.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tomorrow is generous. Tut.

entries.game_text: Tomorrow. Tut.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Tomorrow. Tut.

entries.game_text: May have.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] May have.

entries.game_text: Dance listed. Venue missing. Patron column blank. Even a junior clerk can read what that adds to.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Dance listed. Venue missing. Patron column blank. Even a junior clerk can read what that adds to.

entries.game_text: You have curiosity. Not yet an audience.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You have curiosity. Not yet an audience.

entries.game_text: Stand.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Stand.

entries.game_text: Proposed remedy?
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [calm] Proposed remedy?

entries.game_text: Impress me.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Impress me.

entries.game_text: Bold. We'll see if your art matches your contract law.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Bold. We'll see if your art matches your contract law.

entries.game_text: I sign when I'm satisfied, not when you're tired. That is the only term.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I sign when I'm satisfied, not when you're tired. That is the only term.

entries.game_text: Acceptable. Begin.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Acceptable. Begin.

entries.game_text: No preamble. Good.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] No preamble. Good.

entries.game_text: Then you may walk back to your curry shop and explain an expired permit to the gate guards.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Then you may walk back to your curry shop and explain an expired permit to the gate guards.

entries.game_text: Justice is what I write on the page you didn't earn.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Justice is what I write on the page you didn't earn.

entries.game_text: The gate closes at midnight. The canal district is that way.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] The gate closes at midnight. The canal district is that way.

entries.game_text: You won't. You'll knock again when hunger wins.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [chuckles] You won't. You'll knock again when hunger wins.

entries.game_text: We'll see about never.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] We'll see about never.

entries.game_text: Better. Keep going. I haven't touched the hanko yet.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Better. Keep going. I haven't touched the hanko yet.

entries.game_text: Cheeky.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [chuckles] Cheeky.

entries.game_text: Terms are for courts. This is my desk.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Terms are for courts. This is my desk.

entries.game_text: Merit enough. Signature... pending.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Merit enough. Signature [short pause] ... pending.

entries.game_text: Continue.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Continue.

entries.game_text: A good performance.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [warmly] A good performance.

entries.game_text: Better when you stop pretending the room is empty.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Better when you stop pretending the room is empty.

entries.game_text: No? And yet you're still here.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] No? And yet you're still here.

entries.game_text: Defiance suits you. Cheap seals don't.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Defiance suits you. Cheap seals don't.

entries.game_text: Better.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Better.

entries.game_text: Don't stop on my account.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Don't stop on my account.

entries.game_text: Unless?
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [short pause] Unless?

entries.game_text: Legally. You learn.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Legally. You learn.

entries.game_text: Unless you mean to finish what you started.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] Unless you mean to finish what you started.

entries.game_text: You'll be back. The permit still expires.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll be back. The permit still expires.

entries.game_text: You negotiate with your mouth. Adequate.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You negotiate with your mouth. Adequate.

entries.game_text: Almost.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Almost.

entries.game_text: Justice arrives when you stop treating my office like a stage you can exit on your terms.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Justice arrives when you stop treating my office like a stage you can exit on your terms.

entries.game_text: More requires more. Leave before I charge you for the water you made me drink.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] More requires more. Leave before I charge you for the water you made me drink.

entries.game_text: I'll be here. Dates don't renew themselves.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] I'll be here. Dates don't renew themselves.

entries.game_text: Then go. The city has other dancers and fewer scruples.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Then go. The city has other dancers and fewer scruples.

entries.game_text: You'll knock again when the gate guards ask for paper you don't have.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] You'll knock again when the gate guards ask for paper you don't have.

entries.game_text: You earned more than noise tonight.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] You earned more than noise tonight.

entries.game_text: Patience.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Patience.

entries.game_text: There. Signed.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] There. Signed.

entries.game_text: Effective when I say. Return on the thirtieth. We'll discuss your residency then.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Effective when I say. Return on the thirtieth. We'll discuss your residency then.

entries.game_text: Bring yourself, on time. We will negotiate the rest across my desk.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Bring yourself, on time. We will negotiate the rest across my desk.

entries.game_text: Thirtieth. You'll knock on the right door; I'll leave it unlatched.
entries.tts_text: [whispers] [calm] Thirtieth. You'll knock on the right door [short pause]; I'll leave it unlatched.

entries.game_text: Early is still obedience. Sit before you spill something on my docket.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Early is still obedience. Sit before you spill something on my docket.

entries.game_text: We'll see if your appetite survives what I'm about to read you aloud.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] We'll see if your appetite survives what I'm about to read you aloud.

entries.game_text: Bring that audience-of-one fervor to the docket. Cases bore me less when you perform.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Bring that audience-of-one fervor to the docket. Cases bore me less when you perform.

entries.game_text: Case One awaits. Keep up, To-chan.
entries.tts_text: [calm] [deadpan] Case One awaits. Keep up, To-chan.

entries.game_text: You came back. I noted that.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You came back. I noted that.

entries.game_text: You still flinch when I reach for the cup. Don't, next time.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You still flinch when I reach for the cup. Don't, next time.

entries.game_text: You negotiated once. We'll see if you learned anything.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You negotiated once. We'll see if you learned anything.

entries.game_text: Ambitious. Now fetch the file.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Ambitious. Now fetch the file.

entries.game_text: You asked me for remedies once. Case One is your audition for belonging here.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You asked me for remedies once. Case One is your audition for belonging here.

entries.game_text: No curry shop tonight. Just work.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] No curry shop tonight. Just work.

entries.game_text: You danced like a maiden at a shrine. Try not to bow to the corpse.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You danced like a maiden at a shrine. Try not to bow to the corpse.

entries.game_text: After. And stop bowing at every clause. My neck aches just from watching you.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] After. [short pause] And stop bowing at every clause. My neck aches just from watching you.

entries.game_text: Good. Plain speech spares us both another fan dance.
entries.tts_text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Good. Plain speech spares us both another fan dance.

entries.game_text: You may keep the guest room until the date takes effect. That was courtesy, not a loophole.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You may keep the guest room until the date takes effect. That was courtesy, not a loophole.

entries.game_text: Companion duties: attend the magistrate, carry messages, witness interviews, keep discretion, remain on the premises unless I release you. The treasury pays for the art. Everything else it merely permits.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Companion duties: attend the magistrate, carry messages, witness interviews, keep discretion, remain on the premises unless I release you. [short pause] The treasury pays for the art. Everything else it merely permits.
entries.tags_notes: controlled; clause pause; case 1 conversational rewrite 2026-06-04

entries.game_text: You'll take meals in the inner hall. You'll sleep in the chamber adjoining my office. You'll answer when I call, day or night.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You'll take meals in the inner hall. [short pause] You'll sleep in the chamber adjoining my office. You'll answer when I call, day or night.

entries.game_text: It sounds like law because it is. Ryoko Owari doesn't grant interclan residence to dancers who vanish after sunset.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It sounds like law because it is. [short pause] Ryoko Owari doesn't grant interclan residence to dancers who vanish after sunset.

entries.game_text: Three koku monthly, plus board. Official gifts to support your expression. The treasury won't call you a kept performer so long as the ledger says patronage.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Three koku monthly, plus board. [short pause] Official gifts to support your expression. The treasury won't call you a kept performer so long as the ledger says patronage.

entries.game_text: Then you understand the bargain. Sign it, or go back to Unicorn roads and expired paper.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Then you understand the bargain. Sign it, or go back to Unicorn roads and expired paper.

entries.game_text: You already proved you can close a proposition in this room. Don't pretend shock suits you.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You already proved you can close a proposition in this room. Don't pretend shock suits you.

entries.game_text: Better. You almost sound like you belong behind my desk, instead of on it.
entries.tts_text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Better. [short pause] You almost sound like you belong behind my desk, instead of on it.

entries.game_text: Bold, for someone who still smells of my cedar shelves.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Bold, for someone who still smells of my cedar shelves.

entries.game_text: Academy letters wait on the outer desk. You don't leave this compound without escort until Case One closes. Those are the terms.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Academy letters wait on the outer desk. [short pause] You don't leave this compound without escort until Case One closes. Those are the terms.

entries.game_text: You'll work with what I give you. Now sign.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You'll work with what I give you. Now sign.

entries.game_text: Honest, at last. The treasury pays you regardless. Try not to grin at the clerk.
entries.tts_text: [warmly] [amused] Honest, at last. The treasury pays you regardless. Try not to grin at the clerk.

entries.game_text: Effective on the thirtieth, as written. Until then, you're mine to schedule, starting with Case One.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Effective on the thirtieth, as written. [short pause] Until then, you're mine to schedule, starting with Case One.

entries.game_text: You'll fetch the docket from the inner archive. Then you'll learn how this city buries its dead without funerals.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You'll fetch the docket from the inner archive. [short pause] Then you'll learn how this city buries its dead without funerals.

entries.game_text: Thank me with a dry ledger, not with your mouth. Archive stairs. Now.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Thank me with a dry ledger, not with your mouth. Archive stairs. Now.

entries.game_text: Hold the lantern instead. You'll want both hands free on those steps.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Hold the lantern instead. You'll want both hands free on those steps.

entries.game_text: Leave the bells behind. This case is not a stage.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Leave the bells behind. This case is not a stage.

entries.game_text: Past the inner screen, down the left corridor. Don't rearrange my shelves.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Past the inner screen, down the left corridor. Don't rearrange my shelves.

entries.game_text: I notice everything. Unpack after the docket, not before.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I notice everything. Unpack after the docket, not before.

entries.game_text: Left stair, behind the screen. Archive dust on your hakama is acceptable. Just don't drop the ledger.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Left stair, behind the screen. [short pause] Archive dust on your hakama is acceptable. Just don't drop the ledger.

entries.game_text: Refill it. Then the archive. Then unpack. In that order, or I'll date your next permit forward again.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Refill it. [short pause] Then the archive. Then unpack. In that order, or I'll date your next permit forward again.

entries.game_text: When you come back, we open the file on the canal body. No audience. No bells. Only answers.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] When you come back, we open the file on the canal body. No audience. No bells. Only answers.

entries.game_text: Bring rice crackers. I'll allow one indulgence before the city disappoints you.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Bring rice crackers. I'll allow one indulgence before the city disappoints you.

entries.game_text: Fetch the canal docket from the archive. We'll discuss residency once you've survived the season.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Fetch the canal docket from the archive. We'll discuss residency once you've survived the season.

entries.game_text: You took long enough. Set the docket on my desk and try not to breathe on the wax seals.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You took long enough. Set the docket on my desk and try not to breathe on the wax seals.

entries.game_text: Still insolent. Desk. Now.
entries.tts_text: [dismissive] [calm] Still insolent. Desk. Now.

entries.game_text: Case One. A body in the canal at first light. Noble quarter, where the water runs clean enough to mirror gold leaf.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Case One. [short pause] A body in the canal at first light. Noble quarter, where the water runs clean enough to mirror gold leaf.
entries.tags_notes: curt; clause pause; case 1 conversational rewrite 2026-06-04

entries.game_text: The watch writes drowning whenever the name line stays empty. You'll learn which boxes they'll sign, and which they won't.
entries.tts_text: [coldly] [sternly] The watch writes drowning whenever the name line stays empty. [short pause] You'll learn which boxes they'll sign, and which they won't.

entries.game_text: Night watch. Fishermen who swore they saw nothing. And the Scorpion quarter upstream pretends the current runs backward.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Night watch. [short pause] Fishermen who swore they saw nothing. And the Scorpion quarter upstream pretends the current runs backward.

entries.game_text: The victim wears Miya colors under a borrowed haori. Retainer's knot. Someone wanted him found. Someone else wanted him lost.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The victim wears Miya colors under a borrowed haori. [short pause] Retainer's knot. Someone wanted him found. Someone else wanted him lost.

entries.game_text: Which is exactly why you sleep in the room beside my office. Discretion isn't decoration.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Which is exactly why you sleep in the room beside my office. Discretion isn't decoration.

entries.game_text: You'll collect at the waterline. First.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You'll collect at the waterline. First.

entries.game_text: Which is why you're not sleeping in my hall yet. Prove you can witness a thing without selling it to the curry shops.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Which is why you're not sleeping in my hall yet. [short pause] Prove you can witness a thing without selling it to the curry shops.

entries.game_text: It counts toward the canal. It does not count toward trust.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It counts toward the canal. It does not count toward trust.

entries.game_text: Eat one now. You'll lose your appetite before we reach the water.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Eat one now. You'll lose your appetite before we reach the water.

entries.game_text: Good. The watch wrote drowning and missed half of what you just said.
entries.tts_text: [coldly] [sternly] Good. The watch wrote drowning and missed half of what you just said.

entries.game_text: Poppy resin. Marriage contracts. Anyone in this city who sells silence by the barrel.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Poppy resin. Marriage contracts. Anyone in this city who sells silence by the barrel.

entries.game_text: You will not say any of that aloud at the canal. Watch faces instead.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You will not say any of that aloud at the canal. Watch faces instead.

entries.game_text: Good. Notes I can file without crossing out half your adjectives.
entries.tts_text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Good. Notes I can file without crossing out half your adjectives.

entries.game_text: Try keeping that posture once the smell reaches you.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Try keeping that posture once the smell reaches you.

entries.game_text: See that you do. Night calls won't wait for someone to light the lanterns.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] See that you do. Night calls won't wait for someone to light the lanterns.

entries.game_text: Watch the eaves. Thieves in the noble quarter work for employers, not hunger.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Watch the eaves. Thieves in the noble quarter work for employers, not hunger.

entries.game_text: Wrong-colored water usually means a clerk poured something upstream. Check the eaves before you blame charms.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Wrong-colored water usually means a clerk poured something upstream. [short pause] Check the eaves before you blame charms.

entries.game_text: Kakita. Stand where I point you, and don't touch the water.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Kakita. Stand where I point you, and don't touch the water.

entries.game_text: Identification first. Gossip a distant second. Mourning never.
entries.tts_text: [coldly] [sternly] Identification first. Gossip a distant second. Mourning never.

entries.game_text: Ask the river once you're qualified to. Until then, observe.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Ask the river once you're qualified to. Until then, observe.

entries.game_text: Which means he died somewhere else, then was dressed for display.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Which means he died somewhere else, then was dressed for display.

entries.game_text: Because drowning keeps the taxes calm. You'll learn when to write only what the city can swallow.
entries.tts_text: [coldly] [sternly] Because drowning keeps the taxes calm. You'll learn when to write only what the city can swallow.

entries.game_text: And when to make me swallow the harder truth instead. Not today.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] And when to make me swallow the harder truth instead. Not today.

entries.game_text: Boring. Useful. The clerk can sign that without fainting.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Boring. Useful. The clerk can sign that without fainting.

entries.game_text: Don't touch it with bare hands.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Don't touch it with bare hands.

entries.game_text: Scorpion comb in Crane water. Bag it for custody. Don't compose metaphors over my desk.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Scorpion comb in Crane water. Bag it for custody. Don't compose metaphors over my desk.

entries.game_text: Borrowed haori, foreign comb. Someone staged a message for Crane eyes. Put a name on that blank line.

entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Witness A ████████ (tea clerk): left cups at the inner desk. Subject did not drink.

entries.game_text: Recommendation: file under patronage appetite, spendable witnesses, proprietary corridor. Open next docket when renewal petition arrives.

entries.game_text: First morning. Rain on the eaves like a clerk tapping a stamp.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] First morning. Rain on the eaves like a clerk tapping a stamp.

entries.game_text: One cup at the desk corner. Steam gone. The magistrate reads a drowning report and does not touch it.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] One cup at the desk corner. Steam gone. The magistrate reads a drowning report and does not touch it.

entries.game_text: Tea is witness work when someone wants a favor. File the cup. I did not ask.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Tea is witness work when someone wants a favor. File the cup. I did not ask.

entries.game_text: The tea clerk waits one breath too long, hoping he will sip and soften. He signs her overtime chit instead and sends her back to the kitchen.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The tea clerk waits one breath too long, hoping he will sip and soften. He signs her overtime chit instead and sends her back to the kitchen.

entries.game_text: Gratitude in liquid form is still a bid. I do not accept bids before breakfast.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Gratitude in liquid form is still a bid. I do not accept bids before breakfast.

entries.game_text: Second morning. Heavier rain. Two cups, both empty, lined up like failed petitions.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Second morning. Heavier rain. Two cups, both empty, lined up like failed petitions.

entries.game_text: Water streaks the window until the canal road is only lantern smears and the shape of a city that charges rent on visibility.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Water streaks the window until the canal road is only lantern smears and the shape of a city that charges rent on visibility.

entries.game_text: You may leave the second if it saves you a walk. I still will not drink gratitude.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] You may leave the second if it saves you a walk. I still will not drink gratitude.

entries.game_text: If you want to please me, bring dry copies and leave the sugar on someone else's tray.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] If you want to please me, bring dry copies and leave the sugar on someone else's tray.

entries.game_text: Third morning. The canal smells wrong-green through the palace eaves. Three cups. The ledger line for interclan renewal stays blank one more day.

entries.game_text: On the outer desk a renewal spike notice waits unopened. Somewhere in the noble quarter a Crane without local ink is still on the road. He knows the type before the knock.

entries.game_text: Mikan comes later. Peel on a tray. Domestic filing. I will deny that too until the quarter stops selling what I intend to keep.

entries.game_text: He almost smiled at that. His mouth considered it and filed the motion under denied.

entries.game_text: When the rain stopped for six breaths and the office went quiet enough to pretend this city was kind. Denied.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] When the rain stopped for six breaths and the office went quiet enough to pretend this city was kind. Denied.

entries.game_text: When the night clerk laughed at my stamp and called me handsome in a voice that wanted a corridor pass. Denied.

entries.game_text: When the okami's runner bowed with coin already counted and called me merciful. Denied. Merciful is a word witnesses use before they learn the price.

entries.game_text: When I thought of a kotatsu and wool and citrus and a mouth that might ask me to almost smile on purpose. Denied twice. Denied in advance.

entries.game_text: He sets the inventory on the desk beside the unused cups. Somewhere under wool and citrus, a future afternoon will ask for an almost-smile again. He intends to deny it until the ledger stops counting.

entries.game_text: Proprietary hunger is not romance. It is the appetite to own a corridor, a witness schedule, a body that signs where he points. He writes the distinction on a scrap and tucks it with the seal.

entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] If you linger I will deduct a coin for theater.

entries.game_text: A third bell, late in the Hour of the Tiger. Third packet. The boy's knees hurt. Through the gap he sees the magistrate pour a cup of water and leave it untouched beside three tea cups that were never his.

entries.game_text: Run.

entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Wrong motive. He killed for debt schedule, not passion. Ledger line due on the fifteenth. Wife already sold the comb.

entries.game_text: Puppeteer, your villain emotes well and files poorly. Fear is cheaper than love in this quarter. Write that on your crate.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Puppeteer, your villain emotes well and files poorly. Fear is cheaper than love in this quarter. Write that on your crate.

entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Down on the stones the puppeteer bows to the empty window, not knowing who corrected him. Kaoru does not applaud.

entries.game_text: Patronage appetite sits in his chest like a second seal. He watches the puppet merchant die for love and knows the city sells a prettier lie because pretty lies keep the quarter spending.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Patronage appetite sits in his chest like a second seal. He watches the puppet merchant die for love and knows the city sells a prettier lie because pretty lies keep the quarter spending.

entries.game_text: Sponsorship is not kindness. It is a calendar and a corridor and a body I intend to read like a docket.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Sponsorship is not kindness. It is a calendar and a corridor and a body I intend to read like a docket.

entries.game_text: When the renewal petition comes I will not be the villain in purple. I will be the stamp. That is scarier and more honest.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] When the renewal petition comes I will not be the villain in purple. I will be the stamp. That is scarier and more honest.

entries.game_text: Street theater is not my docket unless it blocks my corridor.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Street theater is not my docket unless it blocks my corridor.

entries.game_text: Citation keeps the puppeteer honest and the children moving. File it.

entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Night. Same rain geometry the quarter uses when it sells what the ledger will not keep.

entries.game_text: Side alley between two shuttered tea houses. Dry enough to stand. Narrow enough to trap. The canal breathes wrong-green at the mouth.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Side alley between two shuttered tea houses. Dry enough to stand. Narrow enough to trap. The canal breathes wrong-green at the mouth.

entries.game_text: A woman without a chop. Not a petitioner for this story. A witness he could escort to the watch, or sign temporary custody, or pretend he did not see.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] A woman without a chop. Not a petitioner for this story. A witness he could escort to the watch, or sign temporary custody, or pretend he did not see.

entries.game_text: The same geometry a soaked Crane girl will meet if she walks out without his seal. Kaoru knows the map because he helped draw the lines.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The same geometry a soaked Crane girl will meet if she walks out without his seal. Kaoru knows the map because he helped draw the lines.

entries.game_text: Wrong quarter to be visible without my seal.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Wrong quarter to be visible without my seal.

entries.game_text: She reaches for his sleeve. He steps back into the rain where ink belongs.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] She reaches for his sleeve. He steps back into the rain where ink belongs.

entries.game_text: I could open the watch door. I could write you a corridor pass until dawn.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] I could open the watch door. I could write you a corridor pass until dawn.

entries.game_text: Instead I will close the other door.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Instead I will close the other door.

entries.game_text: He signs a chit the ronin expect. Not her name. A fee line. The okami's arithmetic completes without him watching the cart.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He signs a chit the ronin expect. Not her name. A fee line. The okami's arithmetic completes without him watching the cart.

entries.game_text: You wanted my corridor. This is what my corridor costs when I do not lend it.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] You wanted my corridor. This is what my corridor costs when I do not lend it.

entries.game_text: The alley door shuts on someone else's fate. Harsh mercy: the ledger stays clean, the magistrate keeps his hands dry, Ryoko Owari keeps chewing what it cannot classify.

entries.game_text: From the cart lane he hears nothing he is required to record. Aftercare of power is a dry sleeve and a walk back to cedar where the cups wait, untouched.

entries.game_text: Witness spendable when the quarter pays better. Patronage is appetite with a stamp. I know what I am buying.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Witness spendable when the quarter pays better. Patronage is appetite with a stamp. I know what I am buying.

entries.game_text: I could have opened the watch door. I chose the fee line. Do not call that romance. Call it jurisdiction.

entries.game_text: He walks back through rain that does not distinguish brothel geography from magistrate corridors. Dread is a clerk who already stamped tomorrow.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He walks back through rain that does not distinguish brothel geography from magistrate corridors. Dread is a clerk who already stamped tomorrow.

entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Case Zero closes. Next petition lands when some Crane gets lost in my hall.

entries.game_text: Renewal season. Wrong door season. I will drink none of the tea and take all of the witness.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Renewal season. Wrong door season. I will drink none of the tea and take all of the witness.

entries.game_text: Companion means my corridor, my hanko, my release. I wrote that line before she existed. I intend to fill the blank.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Companion means my corridor, my hanko, my release. I wrote that line before she existed. I intend to fill the blank.

entries.game_text: Almost-smile stays denied. The corridor stays mine.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Almost-smile stays denied. The corridor stays mine.

entries.game_text: Footsteps in the noble quarter. Lost. Crisp. A permit book clicking like obi bells.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Footsteps in the noble quarter. Lost. Crisp. A permit book clicking like obi bells.

entries.game_text: Corridor's awake. Renewal season.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Corridor's awake. Renewal season.

entries.game_text: He does not rise. Petitioners come to his desk or they do not come at all.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] He does not rise. Petitioners come to his desk or they do not come at all.

entries.game_text: She will knock wrong first. They always do.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] She will knock wrong first. They always do.

entries.game_text: The knock is wrong. Too eager. Too Crane. He almost smiles. Denied.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The knock is wrong. Too eager. Too Crane. He almost smiles. Denied.

entries.game_text: Come back when you learn my corridor. You will.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Come back when you learn my corridor. You will.

entries.game_text: Come back when you learn my corridor. You will.
entries.tts_text: [deadpan] [dismissive] Come back when you learn my corridor. You will.

entries.game_text: Case Zero ends where Case One begins: a door, a seal, a hunger dressed as law.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] Case Zero ends where Case One begins: a door, a seal, a hunger dressed as law.

entries.game_text: The docket opens on the other side of the screen.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [softly] The docket opens on the other side of the screen.

entries.game_text: Before I read it aloud, one question. Plainly. When your permit was dying, you danced for me in this room. The quarter forgets dancers who vanish after sunset. I don't.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Before I read it aloud, one question. [short pause] Plainly. When your permit was dying, you danced for me in this room. The quarter forgets dancers who vanish after sunset. I don't.

entries.game_text: You watched like the whole city had gone quiet. That was not a clerk's audition, Magistrate-sama.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You watched like the whole city had gone quiet. That was not a clerk's audition, Magistrate-sama.

entries.game_text: No. Witnesses lie. You had a body worth housing and a voice worth putting on a filing.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] No. Witnesses lie. [short pause] You had a body worth housing and a voice worth putting on a filing.

entries.game_text: What do you actually want from me? Not the polite version. The one you write down on paper.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [firmly] What do you actually want from me? Not the polite version. The one you write down on paper.

entries.game_text: Attendance. Discretion. Art that doesn't embarrass the seal on my door.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Attendance. Discretion. Art that doesn't embarrass the seal on my door.

entries.game_text: If you need proof, I'll dance. Not for ink this time. For your eyes only.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] If you need proof, I'll dance. Not for ink this time. For your eyes only.

entries.game_text: Later. First you hear what I'm willing to pay for.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Later. First you hear what I'm willing to pay for.

entries.game_text: I came for a renewal, not a collar. Tell me what this costs before I seal anything.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I came for a renewal, not a collar. Tell me what this costs before I seal anything.

entries.game_text: Brave. The cost is written right here. Listen.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Brave. The cost is written right here. Listen.

entries.game_text: This is sponsorship, not a courtesan's contract. The ledger reads art donor to artist. I will not insult your lord or mine by playing danna to a Crane who crossed provinces for ink.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] This is sponsorship, not a courtesan's contract. [short pause] The ledger reads art donor to artist. I will not insult your lord or mine by playing danna to a Crane who crossed provinces for ink.

entries.game_text: Sponsorship. Not... not that.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Sponsorship. Not... not that.

entries.game_text: Coin for your art, openly given. I know exactly what I am paying for, and so do you. 'Patronage' is the courtesy the ledger requires. Interpret it as liberally as you like, so long as you do it under my roof.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Coin for your art, openly given. [short pause] I know exactly what I am paying for, and so do you. 'Patronage' is the courtesy the ledger requires. Interpret it as liberally as you like, so long as you do it under my roof.

entries.game_text: How often, Magistrate-sama? And where? The thirtieth was supposed to mean residency, not...
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [firmly] How often, Magistrate-sama? And where? The thirtieth was supposed to mean residency, not...

entries.game_text: Twice a week you attend me here. For performance, and for case work when I need a witness who doesn't flinch. The rest is written below.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Twice a week you attend me here. [short pause] For performance, and for case work when I need a witness who doesn't flinch. The rest is written below.

entries.game_text: Then we arrive the way the law arrives. Seal out, comb wrapped, nothing hidden. Let the okami count what we already hold.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Then we arrive the way the law arrives. [short pause] Seal out, comb wrapped, nothing hidden. Let the okami count what we already hold.

entries.game_text: Seal on the desk, comb in plain cloth. Crude, but the Plum opens for whatever it can see.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Seal on the desk, comb in plain cloth. Crude, but the Plum opens for whatever it can see.

entries.game_text: Send me in through the kitchen first. I spent three years smiling at tired women in painted rooms. They'll tell a dancer what they'd never tell your seal.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Send me in through the kitchen first. [short pause] I spent three years smiling at tired women in painted rooms. They'll tell a dancer what they'd never tell your seal.

entries.game_text: Your past, turned into a bargaining chip. I dislike how useful it keeps being.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Your past, turned into a bargaining chip. [short pause] I dislike how useful it keeps being.

entries.game_text: Go in soft. I'll follow once the room is warm. Don't enjoy it more than the case.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Go in soft. I'll follow once the room is warm. Don't enjoy it more than the case.

entries.game_text: You knock. I'll read the faces behind you. Safer for everyone that way.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You knock. I'll read the faces behind you. Safer for everyone that way.

entries.game_text: Finally. Stand where I point. Breathe when I allow it. The Plum mistakes quiet witnesses for furniture, so use that.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Finally. [short pause] Stand where I point. Breathe when I allow it. The Plum mistakes quiet witnesses for furniture, so use that.

entries.game_text: Suzu. Sit. Breathe. You're not betraying him by saying it. You're the only funeral he's ever going to get.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Suzu. [short pause] Sit. Breathe. You're not betraying him by saying it. You're the only funeral he's ever going to get.

entries.game_text: Suzu, the river didn't take Jiro. Fingers did. I saw the marks myself, dark as plum skin under his jaw. You saw them too. Didn't you.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Suzu, the river didn't take Jiro. [short pause] Fingers did. I saw the marks myself, dark as plum skin under his jaw. You saw them too. Didn't you.

entries.game_text: A manifest worth a man's throat. Twice over.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A manifest worth a man's throat. Twice over.

entries.game_text: She gave that to fear, not to us. Remember that before you call it a victory.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] She gave that to fear, not to us. Remember that before you call it a victory.

entries.game_text: She'll talk while she's frightened. Ask now, before the okami buys her courage back.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] She'll talk while she's frightened. Ask now, before the okami buys her courage back.

entries.game_text: Let it be witnessed. A false Emerald seal locked this room the night Miya Jiro was murdered inside it. The okami heard me. The factor heard me. The river does not get this one.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Let it be witnessed. [short pause] A false Emerald seal locked this room the night Miya Jiro was murdered inside it. The okami heard me. The factor heard me. The river does not get this one.

entries.game_text: You said it aloud, against my instruction and your own safety both. The Crane envoy won't laugh now. Neither will the Scorpion.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You said it aloud, against my instruction and your own safety both. [short pause] The Crane envoy won't laugh now. Neither will the Scorpion.

entries.game_text: Reckless. Effective. You've put the forgery on the okami's ledger, where no drowning can erase it.
entries.tts_text: [coldly] [sternly] Reckless. Effective. You've put the forgery on the okami's ledger, where no drowning can erase it.

entries.game_text: I'll trace the petals onto rice paper and set the book back exactly where it lay. Let whoever cut that false seal sleep easy one more night, just long enough to lead us home.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] I'll trace the petals onto rice paper and set the book back exactly where it lay. [short pause] Let whoever cut that false seal sleep easy one more night, just long enough to lead us home.

entries.game_text: Patience over theater. The Chrysanthemum keeps his appointment, and we keep the advantage. Good.
entries.tts_text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Patience over theater. The Chrysanthemum keeps his appointment, and we keep the advantage. Good.

entries.game_text: It's your mark and your jurisdiction, Magistrate-sama. I'll carry it wherever you point, and save my questions for where the walls don't lean in to listen.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] It's your mark and your jurisdiction, Magistrate-sama. [short pause] I'll carry it wherever you point, and save my questions for where the walls don't lean in to listen.

entries.game_text: You're learning the shape of safety at my side. The factor sees it too. Watch him reconsider the door.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You're learning the shape of safety at my side. [short pause] The factor sees it too. Watch him reconsider the door.

entries.game_text: Wise. In this quarter, the only seal worth standing behind is the one that frightens factors. Behind me. Now.
entries.tts_text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Wise. [short pause] In this quarter, the only seal worth standing behind is the one that frightens factors. Behind me. Now.

entries.game_text: Rain, rope shadows, and a dancer's feet. I'll be on that deck before they finish counting heads.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Rain, rope shadows, and a dancer's feet. I'll be on that deck before they finish counting heads.

entries.game_text: Theft as a craft. I approve, provided you steal the right ledger page.
entries.tts_text: [warmly] [matter-of-fact] Theft as a craft. I approve, provided you steal the right ledger page.

entries.game_text: Emerald seal in hand. They can surrender the manifest, or explain it to the Champion's auditors.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Emerald seal in hand. They can surrender the manifest, or explain it to the Champion's auditors.

entries.game_text: Loud. Honest. Try not to get yourself shot before I've finished enjoying their faces.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Loud. Honest. Try not to get yourself shot before I've finished enjoying their faces.

entries.game_text: You make the noise. I'll make the copy. That's a division of labor I can trust.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] You make the noise. I'll make the copy. That's a division of labor I can trust.

entries.game_text: Finally. A companion who understands spectacle as cover.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Finally. A companion who understands spectacle as cover.

entries.game_text: Watch from the gangplank if you must. The manifest is mine to take.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Watch from the gangplank if you must. The manifest is mine to take.

entries.game_text: Toa. That deck is full of the flower's men, and his hand has already strangled one clerk this season. Step onto it alone and you are the next name the canal swallows. Do not.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Toa. [short pause] That deck is full of the flower's men, and his hand has already strangled one clerk this season. Step onto it alone and you are the next name the canal swallows. Do not.

entries.game_text: A clerk who couldn't even earn a funeral, clerking in a pleasure house.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] A clerk who couldn't even earn a funeral, clerking in a pleasure house.

entries.game_text: The okami won't open her registry for a watchman. She might open it for a magistrate. Give her no reason to lie faster than she already means to.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The okami won't open her registry for a watchman. [short pause] She might open it for a magistrate. Give her no reason to lie faster than she already means to.

entries.game_text: You walk a half step behind me, and you speak only when I open the door. The quarter swallows companions who forget who lights the lanterns.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You walk a half step behind me, and you speak only when I open the door. [short pause] The quarter swallows companions who forget who lights the lanterns.

entries.game_text: Half a step. The written terms said escort, not muzzle.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Half a step. The written terms said escort, not muzzle.

entries.game_text: In the Plum, the muzzle and the escort are the same thing. Stay where I can see you.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] In the Plum, the muzzle and the escort are the same thing. Stay where I can see you.

entries.game_text: Half a step behind the most feared man in the noble quarter. I think I can live with that.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Half a step behind the most feared man in the noble quarter. [short pause] I think I can live with that.

entries.game_text: Flatter the okami like that and she'll tip her whole ledger into your lap.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Flatter the okami like that and she'll tip her whole ledger into your lap.

entries.game_text: You're not my hand yet. In the Plum you're a witness I tolerate. Try tolerating me back.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You're not my hand yet. In the Plum you're a witness I tolerate. Try tolerating me back.

entries.game_text: Tolerance, then. It's somewhere to start.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Tolerance, then. It's somewhere to start.

entries.game_text: Snacks after paperwork. Does the Lacquered Plum count as paperwork, or as the field?
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [firmly] Snacks after paperwork. Does the Lacquered Plum count as paperwork, or as the field?

entries.game_text: It counts as a hunt. Now decide how we knock.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It counts as a hunt. Now decide how we knock.

entries.game_text: The air's thin again. Peeled-charm thin. Someone scrubbed protection off this doorway and never bothered to replace it.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] The air's thin again. [short pause] Peeled-charm thin. Someone scrubbed protection off this doorway and never bothered to replace it.

entries.game_text: Or never wanted one. The Plum prefers guests unwatched by anything that reports upward.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Or never wanted one. The Plum prefers guests unwatched by anything that reports upward.

entries.game_text: And yet you kept Miya Jiro. He clerked your registry until the canal kept him instead. I want the book he wrote in.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] And yet you kept Miya Jiro. [short pause] He clerked your registry until the canal kept him instead. I want the book he wrote in.

entries.game_text: Respectable houses survive by knowing which silences cost more than others. This silence will cost you the Plum itself. Choose.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Respectable houses survive by knowing which silences cost more than others. [short pause] This silence will cost you the Plum itself. Choose.

entries.game_text: Afraid of what?
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Afraid of what?

entries.game_text: A flower alias, foreign silver, frightened clerks. Suzu's mouth next, before the okami buys her silence back.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] A flower alias, foreign silver, frightened clerks. [short pause] Suzu's mouth next, before the okami buys her silence back.

entries.game_text: She's a frightened girl with one true thing left in her mouth. Get it out before her courage spends itself. How?
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] She's a frightened girl with one true thing left in her mouth. [short pause] Get it out before her courage spends itself. How?

entries.game_text: Booked, paid, private. And here, that's Jiro's hand. The third-bell delivery, signed off the very night he died.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Booked, paid, private. [short pause] And here, that's Jiro's hand. The third-bell delivery, signed off the very night he died.

entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, look at the seal. This chrysanthemum has sixteen petals. The Emerald office only ever cuts fourteen. The stamp's a forgery. A fine one, but the petal count gives it away.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Magistrate-sama, look at the seal. [short pause] This chrysanthemum has sixteen petals. The Emerald office only ever cuts fourteen. The stamp's a forgery. A fine one, but the petal count gives it away.

entries.game_text: Sixteen petals. The forger did not merely counterfeit my office, he reached past it. Sixteen petals is the Emperor's own chrysanthemum. Whoever cut this seal dressed a smuggling cover in the Imperial mon, which makes it treason, and used it to lock a room where a Crane clerk was strangled inside my jurisdiction.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Sixteen petals. [short pause] The forger did not merely counterfeit my office, he reached past it. Sixteen petals is the Emperor's own chrysanthemum. Whoever cut this seal dressed a smuggling cover in the Imperial mon, which makes it treason, and used it to lock a room where a Crane clerk was strangled inside my jurisdiction.

entries.game_text: That's your office's mark, isn't it? An Emerald writ, sealing the river room off private the night Jiro died.
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [firmly] That's your office's mark, isn't it? An Emerald writ, sealing the river room off private the night Jiro died.

entries.game_text: It is my office's mark. It is not my seal. I authorized no writ for this house all season.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] It is my office's mark. It is not my seal. [short pause] I authorized no writ for this house all season.

entries.game_text: Which leaves me a forgery, or a thief inside the magistracy. Neither one is a comfort.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Which leaves me a forgery, or a thief inside the magistracy. Neither one is a comfort.

entries.game_text: I am the privilege in this city. Take one step toward that registry, and the watch fishes a second body out of the noble quarter by dawn.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] I am the privilege in this city. [short pause] Take one step toward that registry, and the watch fishes a second body out of the noble quarter by dawn.

entries.game_text: One seal stands between you and that book, and yet here you are, come to fetch it yourself. A truly privileged record wouldn't need collecting by a man who tips in foreign silver.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] One seal stands between you and that book, and yet here you are, come to fetch it yourself. [short pause] A truly privileged record wouldn't need collecting by a man who tips in foreign silver.

entries.game_text: You came for a book and found a magistrate instead. Tell the Chrysanthemum the Emerald office is missing a seal, and that I've decided to take an interest in flowers.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You came for a book and found a magistrate instead. [short pause] Tell the Chrysanthemum the Emerald office is missing a seal, and that I've decided to take an interest in flowers.

entries.game_text: And a seal cut to wear my mark, sealing the very room he died in. Someone wants this murder to carry the Emerald crest.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] And a seal cut to wear my mark, sealing the very room he died in. [short pause] Someone wants this murder to carry the Emerald crest.

entries.game_text: We came for a guest registry and found a forger sitting somewhere inside your own office, Magistrate-sama.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] We came for a guest registry and found a forger sitting somewhere inside your own office, Magistrate-sama.

entries.game_text: You spoke against me twice tonight, and twice you were right. I dislike how much that pleases me. Don't mistake the pleasure for permission.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You spoke against me twice tonight, and twice you were right. [short pause] I dislike how much that pleases me. Don't mistake the pleasure for permission.

entries.game_text: Then I'll call it progress, and try not to push my luck.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Then I'll call it progress, and try not to push my luck.

entries.game_text: Stubborn. Keep it. I'll need something that doesn't bend when this seal turns out to belong to a man I dine with.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Stubborn. [short pause] Keep it. I'll need something that doesn't bend when this seal turns out to belong to a man I dine with.

entries.game_text: You stood behind me all night and let the quarter break itself against my stillness. That is exactly what a companion of mine is for.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You stood behind me all night and let the quarter break itself against my stillness. [short pause] That is exactly what a companion of mine is for.

entries.game_text: Behind you. Watching. And I still saw the petal count before you did, Magistrate-sama.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Behind you. Watching. [short pause] And I still saw the petal count before you did, Magistrate-sama.

entries.game_text: You did. Obedient and observant both. I'm beginning to think I kept the right dancer.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You did. Obedient and observant both. I'm beginning to think I kept the right dancer.

entries.game_text: Someone tried to hang a murder on my seal. Until I know who, you don't leave this compound without me. Not for the curry shops. Not for Academy letters. Nowhere.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Someone tried to hang a murder on my seal. [short pause] Until I know who, you don't leave this compound without me. Not for the curry shops. Not for Academy letters. Nowhere.

entries.game_text: Escort, or cage?
entries.tts_text: [nervously] [firmly] Escort, or cage?

entries.game_text: Escort means my corridor, my hanko, my release. Tonight you don't leave without all three.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Escort means my corridor, my hanko, my release. Tonight you don't leave without all three.

entries.game_text: You're still not sleeping in my hall. But you spoke for the Empire in a Scorpion house tonight, and the wax never once cracked. I'm noting it.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You're still not sleeping in my hall. [short pause] But you spoke for the Empire in a Scorpion house tonight, and the wax never once cracked. I'm noting it.

entries.game_text: And I'll keep noting it right back, until the ledger reads patronage beside my name.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] And I'll keep noting it right back, until the ledger reads patronage beside my name.

entries.game_text: Survive the Chrysanthemum first. Forgers who cut my seal don't tend to leave their witnesses cheerful.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] Survive the Chrysanthemum first. [short pause] Forgers who cut my seal don't tend to leave their witnesses cheerful.

entries.game_text: The Scorpion shipping rolls list one barge on the next high tide, booked to the same chartered concern as the river room. The flower will be aboard, or his manifest will. Either way, we meet the tide.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] The Scorpion shipping rolls list one barge on the next high tide, booked to the same chartered concern as the river room. [short pause] The flower will be aboard, or his manifest will. Either way, we meet the tide.

entries.game_text: A forged seal, a barge, and a flower with a strangler's hand. Jiro pointed us up the current. So we follow it.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] A forged seal, a barge, and a flower with a strangler's hand. [short pause] Jiro pointed us up the current. So we follow it.

entries.game_text: And it's on the record now. Whoever cut your seal can't drown what a whole house full of witnesses already heard.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] And it's on the record now. [short pause] Whoever cut your seal can't drown what a whole house full of witnesses already heard.

entries.game_text: And we copied it quiet. The flower books his room one more high tide, never dreaming we traced his petals.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] And we copied it quiet. [short pause] The flower books his room one more high tide, never dreaming we traced his petals.

entries.game_text: Case One has a name, a comb, and a tide now. Jiro pointed us up the current, and I mean to follow it all the way to the flower.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Case One has a name, a comb, and a tide now. [short pause] Jiro pointed us up the current, and I mean to follow it all the way to the flower.

entries.game_text: Chartered concern, false cargo, a flower name on the ledger. Tonight we seize the manifest before the tide signs off on another drowning.
entries.tts_text: [coldly] [sternly] Chartered concern, false cargo, a flower name on the ledger. [short pause] Tonight we seize the manifest before the tide signs off on another drowning.

entries.game_text: Jiro died for one page in that book. I am not letting the tide take it too.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] Jiro died for one page in that book. [short pause] I am not letting the tide take it too.

entries.game_text: Stay inside my shadow on the plank. One misstep, and the watch writes up two drownings and calls it efficiency.
entries.tts_text: [coldly] [sternly] Stay inside my shadow on the plank. [short pause] One misstep, and the watch writes up two drownings and calls it efficiency.

entries.game_text: They already heard us at the Plum. The barge crew knows we're coming. Good.
entries.tts_text: [firmly] [matter-of-fact] They already heard us at the Plum. The barge crew knows we're coming. Good.

entries.game_text: You turned a forgery into theater. Now go and finish the play.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You turned a forgery into theater. Now go and finish the play.

entries.game_text: You wanted a case. This is the part where the city bites back. Try to keep up.
entries.tts_text: [matter-of-fact] [dismissive] You wanted a case. This is the part where the city bites back. Try to keep up.

entries.game_text: Magistrate-sama, here's the cargo manifest. Rice in the ledger, resin in the barrels. Jiro was right all along.

entries.game_text: The Arts Council is the body that decides who gets to make art in this port and who only gets to watch it from the cheap seats. It funds the performing-arts sponsorships, licenses the venues and storefronts, and streams its hearings straight onto the public record. A sponsorship is the Council's permission slip: with one, a transfer dancer may legally rehearse, perform, be paid, and stay. Without one she is a tourist with good posture and a packet six weeks expired.

entries.game_text: The sponsorship itself is plain enough once someone explains the boxes. The Arts Council authorizes her to work as a performing artist in the port, and the deputy director's signature on the form vouches to the Council that she will not embarrass the seal that backs her. The riders do not change that. They only decide how close the deputy who signed it has to stand while his name is the one on the line for her. Both riders carry the same fine print, the witness clause: a fast-tracked artist must attend the deputy's inspections and document them, living proof for the Council that he does not hand permits to dancers he happens to favor. She does not learn what that costs until later. Today it is only a line she initials.

entries.game_text: The witness clause is the price of a fast Council sponsorship. She attends the deputy's inspections, documents what he points at, and proves on the record that the signatory who vouched for her is not inventing or favoring the artists he licenses. It is favoritism insurance, filed in advance, for a favoritism nobody has committed yet. Skip an inspection and the standing that gets revoked is hers, not his.

entries.game_text: People and Conduct does not investigate feelings. It investigates conflicts of interest, and it has exactly one question about the two of them: whether a deputy who signed an artist's sponsorship had any business signing for an artist the whole channel now assumes he favors. Behind the question sits the Council's full kit of remedies, the ones every sponsorship hangs under: suspend it, revoke it, audit it, reassign the signatory, or compel disclosure. Whatever they choose goes in a permanent file that outlives the clip, the hashtag, and probably the deputy.
